autoCreateBucket.title: Auto Create Bucket
autoCreateBucket.description: Setting the autocreation of the S3 bucket bucketName. This will apply also in case of moveAfterRead option enabled, and it will create the destinationBucket if it doesn't exist already.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: The delimiter which is used in the com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.ListObjectsRequest to only consume objects we are interested in.

forcePathStyle.title: Force Path Style
forcePathStyle.description: Set whether the S3 client should use path-style URL instead of virtual-hosted-style

ignoreBody.title: Ignore Body
ignoreBody.description: If it is true, the S3 Object Body will be ignored completely if it is set to false, the S3 Object will be put in the body. Setting this to true will override any behavior defined by includeBody option.

overrideEndpoint.title: Override Endpoint
overrideEndpoint.description: Set the need for overriding the endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with the uriEndpointOverride option

pojoRequest.title: Pojo Request
pojoRequest.description: If we want to use a POJO request as body or not

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: The policy for this queue to set in the com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3#setBucketPolicy() method.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The prefix which is used in the com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.ListObjectsRequest to only consume objects we are interested in.

region.title: Region
region.description: The region in which the S3 client needs to work. When using this parameter, the configuration will expect the lowercase name of the region (for example, ap-east-1) You'll need to use the name Region.EU_WEST_1.id()

uriEndpointOverride.title: Uri Endpoint Override
uriEndpointOverride.description: Set the overriding uri endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with overrideEndpoint option

customerAlgorithm.title: Customer Algorithm
customerAlgorithm.description: Define the customer algorithm to use in case CustomerKey is enabled

customerKeyId.title: Customer Key Id
customerKeyId.description: Define the id of the Customer key to use in case CustomerKey is enabled

customerKeyMD5.title: Customer Key MD5
customerKeyMD5.description: Define the MD5 of Customer key to use in case CustomerKey is enabled

deleteAfterRead.title: Delete After Read
deleteAfterRead.description: Delete objects from S3 after they have been retrieved. The deleting is only performed if the Exchange is committed. If a rollback occurs, the object is not deleted. If this option is false, then the same objects will be retrieved over and over again in the polls. Therefore, you need to use the Idempotent Consumer EIP in the route to filter out duplicates. You can filter using the AWS2S3Constants#BUCKET_NAME and AWS2S3Constants#KEY headers, or only the AWS2S3Constants#KEY header.

destinationBucket.title: Destination Bucket
destinationBucket.description: Define the destination bucket where an object must be moved when moveAfterRead is set to true.

destinationBucketPrefix.title: Destination Bucket Prefix
destinationBucketPrefix.description: Define the destination bucket prefix to use when an object must be moved, and moveAfterRead is set to true.

destinationBucketSuffix.title: Destination Bucket Suffix
destinationBucketSuffix.description: Define the destination bucket suffix to use when an object must be moved, and moveAfterRead is set to true.

doneFileName.title: Done File Name
doneFileName.description: If provided, Camel will only consume files if a done file exists.

fileName.title: File Name
fileName.description: To get the object from the bucket with the given file name

includeBody.title: Include Body
includeBody.description: If it is true, the S3Object exchange will be consumed and put into the body and closed. If false, the S3Object stream will be put raw into the body and the headers will be set with the S3 object metadata. This option is strongly related to the autocloseBody option. In case of setting includeBody to true because the S3Object stream will be consumed then it will also be closed, while in case of includeBody false then it will be up to the caller to close the S3Object stream. However, setting autocloseBody to true when includeBody is false it will schedule to close the S3Object stream automatically on exchange completion.

includeFolders.title: Include Folders
includeFolders.description: If it is true, the folders/directories will be consumed. If it is false, they will be ignored, and Exchanges will not be created for those

maxConnections.title: Max Connections
maxConnections.description: Set the maxConnections parameter in the S3 client configuration

maxMessagesPerPoll.title: Max Messages Per Poll
maxMessagesPerPoll.description: Gets the maximum number of messages as a limit to poll at each polling. Gets the maximum number of messages as a limit to poll at each polling. The default value is 10. Use 0 or a negative number to set it as unlimited.

moveAfterRead.title: Move After Read
moveAfterRead.description: Move objects from S3 bucket to a different bucket after they have been retrieved. To accomplish the operation, the destinationBucket option must be set. The copy bucket operation is only performed if the Exchange is committed. If a rollback occurs, the object is not moved.

removePrefixOnMove.title: Remove Prefix On Move
removePrefixOnMove.description: Remove the contents of the prefix configuration string from the new S3Object key before copying. For example, if prefix is set to 'demo/notify' and the destinationBucketPrefix is set to 'demo/archive', an S3Object with a key of 'demo/notify/example.txt' will be copied to 'demo/archive/example.txt', rather than the default behavior where the new key is 'demo/archive/demo/notify/example.txt'. Only applicable when moveAfterRead is true.

sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle.title: Send Empty Message When Idle
sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle.description: If the polling consumer did not poll any files, you can enable this option to send an empty message (no body) instead.

autocloseBody.title: Autoclose Body
autocloseBody.description: If this option is true and includeBody is false, then the S3Object.close() method will be called on exchange completion. This option is strongly related to includeBody option. In case of setting includeBody to false and autocloseBody to false, it will be up to the caller to close the S3Object stream. Setting autocloseBody to true, will close the S3Object stream automatically.

bridgeErrorHandler.title: Bridge Error Handler
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exceptionHandler.title: Exception Handler
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.title: Exchange Pattern
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

inProgressRepository.title: In Progress Repository
inProgressRepository.description: A pluggable in-progress repository org.apache.camel.spi.IdempotentRepository. The in-progress repository is used to account the current in progress files being consumed. By default a memory based repository is used.

pollStrategy.title: Poll Strategy
pollStrategy.description: A pluggable org.apache.camel.PollingConsumerPollingStrategy allowing you to provide your custom implementation to control error handling usually occurred during the poll operation before an Exchange have been created and being routed in Camel.

batchMessageNumber.title: Batch Message Number
batchMessageNumber.description: The number of messages composing a batch in streaming upload mode

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: The batch size (in bytes) in streaming upload mode

bufferSize.title: Buffer Size
bufferSize.description: The buffer size (in bytes) in streaming upload mode

deleteAfterWrite.title: Delete After Write
deleteAfterWrite.description: Delete file object after the S3 file has been uploaded

keyName.title: Key Name
keyName.description: Setting the key name for an element in the bucket through endpoint parameter

multiPartUpload.title: Multi Part Upload
multiPartUpload.description: If it is true, camel will upload the file with multipart format. The part size is decided by the partSize option. Camel will only do multipart uploads for files that are larger than the part-size thresholds. Files that are smaller will be uploaded in a single operation.

namingStrategy.title: Naming Strategy
namingStrategy.description: The naming strategy to use in streaming upload mode

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: The operation to do in case the user don't want to do only an upload

partSize.title: Part Size
partSize.description: Set up the partSize which is used in multipart upload, the default size is 25 MB. The minimum size in AWS is 5 MB. Camel will only do multipart uploads for files that are larger than the part-size thresholds. Files that are smaller will be uploaded in a single operation.

restartingPolicy.title: Restarting Policy
restartingPolicy.description: The restarting policy to use in streaming upload mode

storageClass.title: Storage Class
storageClass.description: The storage class to set in the com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.PutObjectRequest request.

streamingUploadMode.title: Streaming Upload Mode
streamingUploadMode.description: When stream mode is true, the upload to bucket will be done in streaming

streamingUploadTimeout.title: Streaming Upload Timeout
streamingUploadTimeout.description: While streaming upload mode is true, this option set the timeout to complete upload

timestampGroupingEnabled.title: Timestamp Grouping Enabled
timestampGroupingEnabled.description: Enable timestamp-based grouping of messages into time windows for file creation. When enabled, messages are grouped by their timestamp header into time windows.

timestampHeaderName.title: Timestamp Header Name
timestampHeaderName.description: The name of the message header containing the timestamp for grouping. Default is CamelMessageTimestamp.

timestampWindowSizeMillis.title: Timestamp Window Size Millis
timestampWindowSizeMillis.description: The size of the time window in milliseconds for timestamp-based grouping. Messages within the same time window will be written to the same file. Default is 300000 (5 minutes).

awsKMSKeyId.title: Aws KMSKey Id
awsKMSKeyId.description: Define the id of KMS key to use in case KMS is enabled

conditionalWritesEnabled.title: Conditional Writes Enabled
conditionalWritesEnabled.description: Uploads the object only if the object key name does not already exist in the bucket specified.

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

useAwsKMS.title: Use Aws KMS
useAwsKMS.description: Define if KMS must be used or not

useCustomerKey.title: Use Customer Key
useCustomerKey.description: Define if Customer Key must be used or not

useSSES3.title: Use SSES3
useSSES3.description: Define if SSE S3 must be used or not

amazonS3Client.title: Amazon S3 Client
amazonS3Client.description: Reference to a com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3 in the registry.

amazonS3Presigner.title: Amazon S3 Presigner
amazonS3Presigner.description: An S3 Presigner for Request, used mainly in createDownloadLink operation

proxyHost.title: Proxy Host
proxyHost.description: To define a proxy host when instantiating the SQS client

proxyPort.title: Proxy Port
proxyPort.description: Specify a proxy port to be used inside the client definition.

proxyProtocol.title: Proxy Protocol
proxyProtocol.description: To define a proxy protocol when instantiating the S3 client

backoffErrorThreshold.title: Backoff Error Threshold
backoffErrorThreshold.description: The number of subsequent error polls (failed due some error) that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

backoffIdleThreshold.title: Backoff Idle Threshold
backoffIdleThreshold.description: The number of subsequent idle polls that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

backoffMultiplier.title: Backoff Multiplier
backoffMultiplier.description: To let the scheduled polling consumer backoff if there has been a number of subsequent idles/errors in a row. The multiplier is then the number of polls that will be skipped before the next actual attempt is happening again. When this option is in use then backoffIdleThreshold and/or backoffErrorThreshold must also be configured.

greedy.title: Greedy
greedy.description: If greedy is enabled, then the ScheduledPollConsumer will run immediately again, if the previous run polled 1 or more messages.

initialDelay.title: Initial Delay
initialDelay.description: Milliseconds before the first poll starts.

repeatCount.title: Repeat Count
repeatCount.description: Specifies a maximum limit of number of fires. So if you set it to 1, the scheduler will only fire once. If you set it to 5, it will only fire five times. A value of zero or negative means fire forever.

runLoggingLevel.title: Run Logging Level
runLoggingLevel.description: The consumer logs a start/complete log line when it polls. This option allows you to configure the logging level for that.

scheduledExecutorService.title: Scheduled Executor Service
scheduledExecutorService.description: Allows for configuring a custom/shared thread pool to use for the consumer. By default each consumer has its own single threaded thread pool.

scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.description: To use a cron scheduler from either camel-spring or camel-quartz component. Use value spring or quartz for built in scheduler

schedulerProperties.title: Scheduler Properties
schedulerProperties.description: To configure additional properties when using a custom scheduler or any of the Quartz, Spring based scheduler. This is a multi-value option with prefix: scheduler.

startScheduler.title: Start Scheduler
startScheduler.description: Whether the scheduler should be auto started.

timeUnit.title: Time Unit
timeUnit.description: Time unit for initialDelay and delay options.

useFixedDelay.title: Use Fixed Delay
useFixedDelay.description: Controls if fixed delay or fixed rate is used. See ScheduledExecutorService in JDK for details.

profileCredentialsName.title: Profile Credentials Name
profileCredentialsName.description: If using a profile credentials provider, this parameter will set the profile name

sessionToken.title: Session Token
sessionToken.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume an IAM role

trustAllCertificates.title: Trust All Certificates
trustAllCertificates.description: If we want to trust all certificates in case of overriding the endpoint

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.title: Use Default Credentials Provider
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.title: Use Profile Credentials Provider
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

useSessionCredentials.title: Use Session Credentials
useSessionCredentials.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in a situation in which the user needs to assume an IAM role for doing operations in S3.
